summary: Listed on the tnlandforms.us Georgia lookout list in Clinch County with BLL 65196 and GFC 822; no source found on build, staffing or the site today.

evidence.supports: listed on the tnlandforms.us list of Georgia lookout towers
entry places the tower in Clinch County with labelled numbers BLL 65196 and GFC 822
the page carries a revision stamp of March 2016

notes_for_editor: Only source found is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (gatowers.html), last stamped March 2016. Its entry gives the name, county, coordinates, elevation and labels only, with no build date, use, status or access. Searched: the cached NHLR Georgia index (31 links, no Clinch, Clito or Cochran tower page), the firetower.org Georgia index (no match), the easternuslookouts Georgia list (no Clinch tower entry), and two web searches on Clinch County and Homerville, which found nothing on a tower. The labels BLL and GFC are not explained on the page, so the story repeats them as printed and does not say what they mean. The lowercase name 'clinch' is the list's own label, not a named lookout. A separate list entry, 'homerville' (GA424, about 2 km away by the listed coordinates, computed), may be the same site; not verified. A reader comment under a Vanishing Georgia post about a former TPO office in Homerville recalls a watch tower on that lot; it is unverified, names no number, and is not used. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports so little. Do not add visit or access claims without a managing-agency source.
